question: What was the home claim frequency by state in Q1 2026?

report.interpretation: Home claim frequency is claims per 1,000 home policies in force per month. I counted claims by loss date in Q1 2026 (Jan–Mar). I divided the claim count by the sum of monthly policy-months from exposure_monthly for the same states and months. Q1 is fully developed, so late reporting has little effect.
report.answer: Q1 2026 home claim frequency, in claims per 1,000 policies per month, was highest in IL (7.13) and OH (6.93). GA (5.34), FL (5.31), TX (5.18) and NY (5.15) were in the middle. NC (3.66) and CA (2.98) were lowest.
report.answer_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT state, count(*) n FROM claims WHERE product='home' AND loss_date>='2026-01-01' AND loss_date<'2026-04-01' GROUP BY 1), e AS (SELECT state, sum(policies_in_force) pm FROM exposure_monthly WHERE product='home' AND month>='2026-01-01' AND month<'2026-04-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT e.state, c.n AS claims, e.pm AS policy_months, round(c.n*1000.0/e.pm,2) AS freq_per_1000_per_month FROM e JOIN c USING(state) ORDER BY 1
